value.message: Town of Oakville offers Learn to Swim Parent and Tot / Preschool levels for preschoolers - their site lists the program but I couldn't get into the fall schedule page today to confirm days, times or price. YMCA of Oakville (ages 3-5) and Goldfish Swim School Oakville (preschool-stage classes) also run preschool swim lessons. I'll keep looking and text you what their pages say.
